figure_label.rationale: Three stacked arrow timelines (Case 1-3) of local patients p1-p3 with printed clock times, days, EG serum levels and events. It is a hand-drawn text timeline, not a primary clinical record or image; its content is already captured as typed events in the annotation. Burned-in identifiers: none (no names, MRN, DOB or calendar dates; only clock times and relative day numbers). Not EHR-includable as an image.
